title: 西洲曲
author: 佚名（南朝乐府）
intro: A young woman south of the Yangtze misses her lover across the river — from plum-blossom time through the lotus summer to the autumn geese. Gentle, musical and full of word-play, it is the loveliest love song of the Southern Dynasties.
analysis: 《西洲曲》是南朝民歌里最长、最美的一首情歌。一位江南女子思念在江北的情郎，诗跟着季节走：春天想起和他在西洲相会，折梅寄给他；夏天在门前等他不来，出门采莲；秋天抬头望飞来的鸿雁，盼着有他的消息；最后登楼远望，整日倚着栏杆，只能把梦托给南风，吹到西洲去。诗里最有名的是“谐音双关”：“莲”和“怜”（爱）同音，“莲子”就是“怜子”（爱你），“莲心彻底红”就是一颗爱你的心红透了——不直说“我爱你”，却句句是爱。另一个特点是“顶针”（前一句的末尾就是后一句的开头）：“……飞鸿。鸿飞……”“……青楼。楼高……”“……栏杆头。栏杆……”，一句接一句，像歌声连绵不断，也像思念一样剪不断。全诗四句一换韵，读起来轻柔婉转。
analysisEn: This is the longest and loveliest love song from the Southern Dynasties. A young woman in the south misses her lover on the north bank of the river, and the poem follows the seasons with her. In spring she remembers meeting him at the West Isle and sends him a sprig of plum. In summer she waits at her gate; he doesn’t come, so she goes out to pick lotus. In autumn she looks up at the wild geese, hoping for news. At last she climbs a tower and leans on the railing all day, and can only ask the south wind to carry her dream to the West Isle. The poem’s great trick is the pun: 莲 lián “lotus” sounds exactly like 怜 lián “to love”. So “lotus seeds” also means “loving you”, and “the lotus heart is red right through” means a heart completely in love — she never says “I love you”, yet every line does. The other trick is chain-linking: one line ends with a word and the next begins with it (“…flying geese. / Geese fly…”, “…the tower. / The tower is high…”), so the song never seems to pause — just like her longing. The rhyme changes every four lines, giving it a soft, swaying rhythm.
background: The song comes from the Southern Dynasties (5th–6th century), probably a folk song polished by literary hands. The Yuefu Shiji (Collection of Yuefu Poems) lists it as anonymous; some early anthologies attribute it to Jiang Yan or to Emperor Wu of Liang, but most scholars treat it as a folk song from the lake country south of the Yangtze.
pronunciation: 伯劳 读 bó láo（一种鸟）。乌臼 读 wū jiù。翠钿 读 cuì diàn。露翠钿的“露”读 lù。栏杆十二曲的“曲”读 qū（弯曲），不读 qǔ。卷帘的“卷”读 juǎn。“莲子”“杏子”的“子”按本调标 zǐ。栏杆现代口语“杆”读轻声，这里按本调标 gān。
version: 采用通行本（据《乐府诗集》卷七十二“杂曲歌辞”）。“乌臼”一作“乌桕”，“栏杆”一作“阑干”，意思相同。《玉台新咏》有的版本题作江淹作，不取。全诗三十二句，网站按一联一行排版，四句一段（共八段）。

lines.zh: 忆梅下西洲，折梅寄江北。
lines.rhythm: 忆梅/下西洲，折梅/寄江北
lines.py: yì méi xià xī zhōu, zhé méi jì jiāng běi
lines.lit: Remembering the plum blossoms, I go down to the West Isle; I break off a plum branch to send north of the river.
lines.en: Thinking of the plum trees, I go down to the West Isle, and snap a sprig to send you across the river.

lines.zh: 单衫杏子红，双鬓鸦雏色。
lines.rhythm: 单衫/杏子红，双鬓/鸦雏色
lines.py: dān shān xìng zǐ hóng, shuāng bìn yā chú sè
lines.lit: My thin robe is apricot red; my two temple-locks are the colour of a young crow.
lines.en: My light robe is apricot red, my hair as glossy black as a fledgling crow.

lines.zh: 西洲在何处？两桨桥头渡。
lines.rhythm: 西洲/在何处，两桨/桥头渡
lines.py: xī zhōu zài hé chù, liǎng jiǎng qiáo tóu dù
lines.lit: Where is the West Isle? Two oars cross over from the bridgehead.
lines.en: Where is the West Isle? A few strokes of the oars from the bridge.

lines.zh: 日暮伯劳飞，风吹乌臼树。
lines.rhythm: 日暮/伯劳飞，风吹/乌臼树
lines.py: rì mù bó láo fēi, fēng chuī wū jiù shù
lines.lit: At sunset the shrikes fly; the wind blows the tallow trees.
lines.en: At dusk the shrikes take wing, and wind stirs the tallow trees.

lines.zh: 树下即门前，门中露翠钿。
lines.rhythm: 树下/即门前，门中/露翠钿
lines.py: shù xià jí mén qián, mén zhōng lù cuì diàn
lines.lit: Under the tree is my gate; in the doorway my kingfisher hairpin shows.
lines.en: The tree stands right by my gate; in the doorway, a glint of my blue-green hairpin.

lines.zh: 开门郎不至，出门采红莲。
lines.rhythm: 开门/郎不至，出门/采红莲
lines.py: kāi mén láng bù zhì, chū mén cǎi hóng lián
lines.lit: I open the gate, my love does not come; I go out the gate to pick red lotus.
lines.en: I open the gate — you don’t come. I go out to gather red lotus.

lines.zh: 采莲南塘秋，莲花过人头。
lines.rhythm: 采莲/南塘秋，莲花/过人头
lines.py: cǎi lián nán táng qiū, lián huā guò rén tóu
lines.lit: Picking lotus at South Pond in autumn, the lotus flowers rise above my head.
lines.en: Gathering lotus on South Pond as autumn comes, the flowers stand taller than I am.

lines.zh: 低头弄莲子，莲子清如水。
lines.rhythm: 低头/弄莲子，莲子/清如水
lines.py: dī tóu nòng lián zǐ, lián zǐ qīng rú shuǐ
lines.lit: Lowering my head I play with the lotus seeds; the lotus seeds are clear as water.
lines.en: I bow my head and toy with the lotus seeds — seeds as pure as water, a love as clear.

lines.zh: 置莲怀袖中，莲心彻底红。
lines.rhythm: 置莲/怀袖中，莲心/彻底红
lines.py: zhì lián huái xiù zhōng, lián xīn chè dǐ hóng
lines.lit: I put the lotus in my sleeve; the lotus heart is red right through.
lines.en: I tuck the lotus into my sleeve; its heart is red all the way through.

lines.zh: 忆郎郎不至，仰首望飞鸿。
lines.rhythm: 忆郎/郎不至，仰首/望飞鸿
lines.py: yì láng láng bù zhì, yǎng shǒu wàng fēi hóng
lines.lit: I think of my love, my love does not come; I raise my head to watch the flying geese.
lines.en: I long for you, and you don’t come; I lift my eyes to the passing geese.

lines.zh: 鸿飞满西洲，望郎上青楼。
lines.rhythm: 鸿飞/满西洲，望郎/上青楼
lines.py: hóng fēi mǎn xī zhōu, wàng láng shàng qīng lóu
lines.lit: The geese fly, filling the West Isle; to look for my love I climb the blue tower.
lines.en: Geese fill the sky over the West Isle; I climb the painted tower to look for you.

lines.zh: 楼高望不见，尽日栏杆头。
lines.rhythm: 楼高/望不见，尽日/栏杆头
lines.py: lóu gāo wàng bù jiàn, jìn rì lán gān tóu
lines.lit: The tower is high, yet I cannot see you; all day I stay by the railing.
lines.en: High as it is, I still can’t see you, and lean on the railing all day long.

lines.zh: 栏杆十二曲，垂手明如玉。
lines.rhythm: 栏杆/十二曲，垂手/明如玉
lines.py: lán gān shí èr qū, chuí shǒu míng rú yù
lines.lit: The railing has twelve bends; my hanging hands are bright as jade.
lines.en: The railing winds through twelve turns; my hands rest on it, pale as jade.

lines.zh: 卷帘天自高，海水摇空绿。
lines.rhythm: 卷帘/天自高，海水/摇空绿
lines.py: juǎn lián tiān zì gāo, hǎi shuǐ yáo kōng lǜ
lines.lit: Rolling up the curtain, the sky is high by itself; the sea-wide water sways, empty and green.
lines.en: I roll up the blind: the sky is high and far, and the wide river rocks, an empty green.

lines.zh: 海水梦悠悠，君愁我亦愁。
lines.rhythm: 海水/梦悠悠，君愁/我亦愁
lines.py: hǎi shuǐ mèng yōu yōu, jūn chóu wǒ yì chóu
lines.lit: Like the wide water, my dream is long and far; if you are sad, I am sad too.
lines.en: My dream drifts on and on like that water; if you are sad, then so am I.

lines.zh: 南风知我意，吹梦到西洲。
lines.rhythm: 南风/知我意，吹梦/到西洲
lines.py: nán fēng zhī wǒ yì, chuī mèng dào xī zhōu
lines.lit: If the south wind knows my heart, it will blow my dream to the West Isle.
lines.en: South wind, you know what I want — carry my dream to the West Isle.

words.en: the West Isle — a sandbar where the lovers once met
words.note: 具体地点不详，诗里是两人相会的地方。
现代汉语“回忆”“记忆”。
古义“前往”；现代汉语“下江南”还保留这个用法。
现代汉语“衬衫”的“衫”。
现代汉语“鬓角”。
雏：幼鸟，现代汉语“雏鸟”。形容头发乌黑发亮。
现代汉语“渡河”“渡口”。

words.en: shrike, a small bird of summer
words.note: 古人认为伯劳和燕子各飞东西，后来有成语“劳燕分飞”，比喻情人分离。
也写作“乌桕”，江南常见的树，秋天叶子变红。

words.en: hairpin inlaid with blue-green kingfisher feathers
words.note: 古代女子的首饰。
古代女子对情人或丈夫的称呼；现代汉语“新郎”。

words.en: lotus seed — punning on 怜子 “loving you”
words.note: “莲”谐音“怜”（爱）；现代汉语“莲子”是常见食物。

words.en: lotus heart (the seed’s core) — punning on “a loving heart”
words.note: 谐音“怜心”，一颗爱人的心。
古义是“透到底”；现代汉语“彻底”引申为“完全”。
古人说鸿雁能传书信，所以望鸿就是盼信。现代汉语“鸿雁传书”。

words.en: a blue-painted tower; a fine house
words.note: 古义只是漆成青色的楼；后来才指歌伎住的地方，和本诗无关。
现代汉语说“整天”。

words.en: (here) the wide river, as broad as a sea
words.note: 古代江南人常把大江大湖叫“海”。
现代汉语“悠悠岁月”。
现代汉语说“也”。

imagery.name: 梅
imagery.zh: 折梅寄江北，是回忆和思念的开头；梅花也点出故事从早春开始。
imagery.en: Sending a sprig of plum north opens her memories — and tells us the story begins in early spring.

imagery.name: 莲
imagery.zh: “莲”谐音“怜”（爱），采莲、弄莲子、莲心红，都是在说她的爱。
imagery.en: Lotus (lián) sounds like “love” (怜 lián): picking lotus, playing with the seeds, the red lotus heart — all of it is her love.

imagery.name: 雁
imagery.zh: 诗里写作“飞鸿”（鸿就是大雁）。传说鸿雁能传书，她仰头望雁，是盼情郎的音信；秋雁南飞也点出季节变化。
imagery.en: The poem calls them 鸿 hóng, big wild geese. Geese were said to carry letters; watching them, she hopes for word from him. Their autumn flight also marks the turning season.

imagery.name: 风
imagery.zh: 南风从江南吹向江北，她请南风把自己的梦带到西洲，带到他身边。
imagery.en: The south wind blows from her shore to his; she asks it to carry her dream to the West Isle, to him.
